text: Monitor for new or worsening symptoms during immune therapy and assess suspected immune-mediated reactions.
A severe infusion reaction requires immediate clinical assessment and management according to applicable product labeling.
Fever after systemic anticancer treatment should prompt assessment for infection and treatment-related complications.
Assess severity, hydration, oral intake and response to antiemetic therapy when nausea or vomiting is reported.
New or worsening shortness of breath requires prompt clinical assessment.
Record drug name, dose, route, frequency and suspected adverse event in treatment documentation.
Assess peripheral neuropathy, numbness, tingling, and nerve impairment; evaluate dose modification for sensory neurotoxicity.
Assess severity of diarrhea, frequency of loose stools, hydration and electrolyte balance; administer loperamide as indicated.
